Soundtrap: Music Production, made simple.

Join millions of creators using Soundtrap – the online studio & app built for making music and recording podcasts, fast. Record vocals, produce beats, collaborate in real time, and mix your songs with pro-level power across your browser and mobile app.

Whether you're capturing a vocal idea on the go or polishing a mix on your laptop, Soundtrap lets you move seamlessly between devices. Start a song on your computer, tweak it on your phone - your studio goes wherever inspiration strikes. That's the future of music creation.

Create your sound with powerful, easy-to-use tools:
• Cross-Device Studio – Switch seamlessly between desktop and mobile. Your projects stay synced in the cloud so you never lose a beat.
• Vocal Suite – Record, tune, and polish your vocals with pro-grade effects and pitch correction that works automatically.
• Playback Anywhere – Stream and listen back to your studio sessions on the go with the mobile app.
• Loops & Sounds – Access thousands of royalty-free loops and samples across every genre, from indie pop to hip-hop and EDM.
• Instruments & Effects – Produce with 400+ built-in instruments. Pianos, synths, drums and more, plus studio effects for mixing and mastering.
• Collaboration in Real Time – Invite friends or bandmates to join your session instantly. Co-create, comment, and record together — wherever you are.
• Mix & Master – Use smart automation and instant mastering to get a professional sound in minutes.
• Cloud-Based Workflow – Every project is backed up automatically, no downloads or hard drives required.
• Built-In Auto-Save & Version History – Keep your progress secure and revisit older takes anytime.
• Browser & Desktop App – Work directly in your browser or use the desktop app for maximum performance.
• Multi-Genre Sound Packs – Discover new inspiration with curated packs designed by producers from around the world.
• Accessible to Everyone – A clean, intuitive interface designed to get you creating faster. 

For every creator, from first beat to final mix:
• Producers: Finish songs faster with intuitive workflows and fast rendering.
• Singers: Record, tune, and layer harmonies with ease.
• Podcasters: Record high-quality audio straight from your browser with simple editing tools.
• Collaborators: Invite anyone to your session, no DAW downloads needed.

Why musicians love Soundtrap:
• Built for simplicity and speed, no learning curve
• Cloud-based, so you can create anywhere
• Trusted by artists, labels & more

Your next song starts here. Bring your idea to life, fast.

n-Track Studio is the ultimate music-making app for iOS that transforms your device into a powerful recording studio and beat maker. 

With the power to record an almost unlimited number of audio, MIDI, and drum tracks, mix them with real-time effects like Guitar Amps, VocalTune & Reverb, n-Track Studio has everything you need to create professional-quality music on the go. You can then share and find new collaborations with other artists in our Songtree community.

With n-Track Studio, the possibilities are endless. Record tracks using the built-in mic or an external audio interface, edit songs using the Loop Browser and royalty-free sample packs, and create beats using the Step Sequencer Beat Maker. You can even use the internal keyboard with built-in virtual instruments, or connect an external keyboard for even more flexibility. 

Other features include:
• Stereo and mono audio tracks
• MIDI tracks with built-in synths
• Piano Roll MIDI editor
• On-screen MIDI keyboard
• EQ with 2D and 3D spectrum analyzer and chromatic tuner VocalTune, Guitar and Bass Amp plugins
• Wide range of effects like Reverb, Noise Reduction, Pitch Shift, Limiter, Echo, Chorus, Flanger, Tremolo, Phaser, Tube Amp, and Compressor. 

n-Track Studio also comes with a built-in metronome, the ability to import existing tracks, and the option to automate track volumes and pan using volume & pan envelopes. With the integrated Songtree online music making community, you can collaborate with other musicians to create music like never before.

Ready to take your music-making skills to the next level? n-Track Studio has you covered with a variety of versions. 

The free edition includes up to 8 tracks and up to 2 effects per track/channel, while the standard subscription ($1.49/month) unlocks unlimited audio and MIDI tracks, all available effects, and the ability to export to WAV or MP3. For even more advanced features, you may want to consider the extended subscription ($2.99/month), which includes a 64-bit audio engine, multichannel USB class-compliant audio interfaces, and the ability to export in 24, 32, and 64-bit uncompressed (WAV) format. And for the ultimate music-making experience, check out the Suite subscription ($5.99/month), which includes 10GB+ of premium royalty-free WAV loops and one-shots, exclusive release-ready beats, and over 400 sample instruments. 

Not sure where to start? Check out n-Track Studio Tutorials for iOS at https://ntrack.com/video-tutorials/ios and get up to speed in no time! And if you like what you see, you can subscribe to unlock a variety of standard and advanced features. 

Languages included: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian.

So what are you waiting for? Download n-Track Studio today and start making music like a pro!

Turn your musical ideas into great-sounding productions. Auxy makes it easy to create modern beats and electronic music—whether you're sketching ideas or producing full tracks.

"Auxy is my favorite way to get what's going on in my brain into a musical format. It's simple on the surface but with tremendous depth if you need it."
– RAC, Grammy Award-winning producer

CREATE LOOPS THAT HIT
Draw notes to craft melodies and drum patterns. Arrange loops into full tracks—or just mess around and see where the music takes you. No fluff. Just flow.

FIND YOUR SOUND
Browse thousands of high-quality instruments and drum hits. Import your own samples to create custom kits and unique melodic sounds.

MIX IT UP
Shape your sound with studio-grade effects like reverb, delay, and distortion. Add energy and movement with powerful automation tools.

DROP IT ANYWHERE
Finished a track? Export high-quality audio or upload straight to SoundCloud. Need some more layers? Export stems or native project files for Ableton Live, Bitwig Studio, and Studio One.

TRY IT FREE
Start making music today with a selection of demo sounds. Unlock everything with a 7-day free trial—no commitment.

MADE IN SWEDEN
We’re a small, independent team making Auxy because we love music and hate unnecessary complexity. We’d love to hear from you—reach out at feedback@auxy.co.

Rapchat is the all-in-one music maker studio where you can record songs, rap, tune your voice, and edit your vocals with AI-powered effects. Whether you’re just freestyling or chasing rap fame, Rapchat gives you everything you need to create music, discover beats, and collaborate with other artists.
 
400,000+ FREE BEATS
Pick from rap, trap, drill, Afrobeats, and more. Browse playlists or create beat playlists to fuel your freestyle, record new songs, or collaborate with other rapstars.

AI VOICE & VOCAL TUNE EFFECTS
Upgrade your vocals with custom AI vocal tune and audio tune presets. Just describe the vibe you want—“audio tune rap vocals” or “studio punch-in effects”—and instantly generate unique sounds. Choose from 100+ presets like Reverb, Vocal Tune, and Freestyle FX to edit songs your way.

CREATE, RECORD & EDIT SONGS
Bring your music to life in a simple but powerful recording studio. Import audio files, layer beats, write lyrics, and edit vocals until your track is tuned to perfection. Every tool you need to create songs, tune your voice, and add effects is built in.

COLLABORATE & FREESTYLE
Work on projects with unlimited artists. Trade song versions, freestyle back and forth, and keep every idea saved in the project history.

GET NOTICED & ACHIEVE RAP FAME
From first freestyle to rapstar status, Rapchat helps you showcase your songs, playlists, and beats. Join open verse challenges, share your music, and climb the charts to get discovered.

APP FEATURES
- 400,000+ free rap beats or import your own
- Full-featured music maker studio
- AI vocal tune and voice effects
- Record songs and edit vocals easily
- Lyric pad for writing and freestyling
- Auto-mastering for professional sound
- Collaborate with unlimited artists on projects
- Save and revisit project versions
- Import audio files into the studio
- Export WAVs or create shareable videos
- Build and share song + beat playlists
- Share your music, grow fans, achieve rap fame

Music-making for everyone. From new musicians looking to get started to experienced producers, Medly has everything you need to unleash your musical spark.

A Best of App Store 2016 winner, Medly’s simple interface is packed with advanced tools to create studio-quality productions. Get started for free with the Starter Pack of 17 instruments and over 100 loops and samples. You can also try Medly Member free for 7 days to unlock over 3500 instruments, loops, and exclusive features.

CREATIVE CONTROL
Music-making can be intimidating. Medly makes it easy by breaking songs down into Sections. You can add notes, audio samples, and loops to your Sections, then copy, paste and rearrange them to build your song. At any time, use the History tool to quickly rewind and undo your changes.

A MAGIC TOUCH TO NOTES
From simply adding a note to complex multi-note editing, each interaction was carefully designed with touch in mind. And with over 300 instruments available to Members, you can quickly try out different sounds and find your style.

AMPLIFIED AUDIO
Edit, snap, and trim your audio clips to your liking. Record or import audio, or use a sample from Medly’s vast audio library. You can record audio up to 4 bars or become a Member and record and import audio up to 30 seconds. As a Member, bring your songs to the next level with professionally recorded vocals by Medly’s talented artists.

POINT PERFECT AUTOMATION
Automatically change volume, echo, and other effects to add fades and pitch bends to your sounds. Snap between points and beats to achieve point perfect precision and use the selection tool to edit multiple automation points together. Then open the effect picker to quickly see the automation graphs of all effects within a Section.

SHARE AND PLAY
Quickly upload your songs to SoundCloud, or share them as a video, audio, MIDI, or Medly file. You can also connect Medly to other apps using Inter-App Audio or play in time using Ableton Link.

MADE IN CANADA
We’re a small team working relentlessly to make Medly possible. We’d love to know what you think about Medly, let us know on Facebook, Twitter, or email us at hi@medlylabs.com


*iPad App of the Year: Japan and South Korea
*iPhone App of the Year Runner-Up: China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan
